references.text: Describes how the bull is to be carried outside the camp and burned, the same practice as in the Day of Atonement ritual
The bull shall be burned outside the camp, just like the sin offering on the Day of Atonement
A sin offering whose blood is brought into the tent sanctuary must be burned with fire, not eaten
Moses burned the bull along with its skin, flesh, and dung outside the camp, mentioning the same elements
The flesh and the skin were burned with fire outside the camp
The red heifer was led outside the camp and completely burned, parallel to the treatment of the sin offering
Hebrews explains that Jesus suffered outside the city gate, just as the bodies of animals were burned outside the camp
